column3: “Strengthened himself on Israel” is rendered “made his position over Israel firm.”
“Walked in the ways of David his ancestor, the former” is rendered “followed the example of his father David's earlier days.”
“According to the deeds of Israel” is rendered “did not act as Israel did.”
“In his hand” is rendered “in his control,” and “gave” as “brought.”
“His heart was high” is rendered “he took great pride”; “Asherah poles” is rendered “Asherim.”
“Tribute and silver a load” is rendered “gifts and silver as tribute.”
“Was going and becoming great upward” is rendered “grew greater and greater.”
“On his hand” is rendered “next to him,” and “Jehohanan” as “Johanan.”
“On his hand” is rendered “next to him.”
“Equipped of bow” is rendered “armed with bow.”
“On his hand” is rendered “next to him.”
